instruction: Return corrected final JSON from the SAME complete catalog. No queries. Only observed-table IDs are measured evidence. PLAN FORMAT: return type selection and the supplied packet_sha256, expert_synthesis with chemistry_takeaways, ml_takeaways, agreements, disagreements, planner_resolution; nonempty batch_strategy, batch_rationale, expected_learning_value and feedback_interpretation. Exactly 32 distinct candidate-table IDs in choices, with id, reason, knowledge_basis (chemistry/machine_learning/observed_feedback) and hypothesis_id or related_hypothesis_id. hypotheses MUST be a LIST of 0..8 objects, each with id, content, why_it_matters_for_model_learning, next_discriminating_question, basis (chemical_prior/observed_data/model_behavior/mixed), confidence (low/medium/high), status (proposed/supported/weakened/rejected/unresolved), supporting_observed_ids and contradicting_observed_ids. Choice hypothesis references must be null or an ID in that list. Only observed-table sample IDs can be measured evidence; candidates and molecule IDs cannot. For prediction-only hypotheses, use empty evidence lists. Keep complete JSON below 28,000 characters.
